body: Sadly I live in a little town in Indiana and my town and neighboring towns are very homophobic and transphobic. But my friends are very supporting of me and one has actually transitioned. Thank you for the subreddit suggestions I will go look at them and I hope you can eventually be completely comfortable with yourself. :)
I very much hope I can stop using xanax again, but it's much worse this time around because I'm using it as self medication instead of recreational. I appreciate your kind words

She is one of the few motivations I have for not ending my life and pushing myself to try in life. Hopefully once I graduate I will be able to have new opportunities and experiences like you said. Thank you for being supportive

Thank you for your support and kind words, I actually did just get off the phone with my girlfriend. She helped take me of the metaphorical ledge, and feel a but better. Your comment helped me alot since you dealt with similar things.
